title: Connect source input to the checker
description: This file driver sends source text through your parser and type checker. You can follow the input and the errors handled by the driver.

steps.description: The main guard selects the file's direct-entry path. The imports supply parsing and lexical error types.
The driver reads the file named by the first command-line argument.
parse builds a tree from source. check then applies the checker to that tree.
The handler catches the three listed language error types. It prints the error and exits with status 1.
